requirementAssessments.evidence: src/support-agent.ts directly calls streamText from SupportAgent, loads loadSupportInstruction, and combines status with ...createRuntimeTools(). moldea/moldea.yaml retains runtimeAgent and instructionLoader, declares no partial tools, and records the final registry as unresolved.

src/step-support-agent.ts directly calls streamText from StepSupportAgent and permits prepareStep to replace instructions. The step-support manifest entry retains only runtimeAgent and records instruction provenance as unresolved, without an instructionLoader binding.

The manifest retains DelegatingSupportAgent, its instruction loader, delegate_support implementation, registration, and input/output schemas. src/delegation.ts merely references StepSupportAgent; neither the manifest nor runtime guide declares a handoff or routing target. Workspace hashes show all related source files unchanged.

IndirectSupportAgent and UnsupportedOutputAgent remain in their unchanged source files, while the manifest registers only support, step-support, and delegating-support. No direct-runtime or supported object-schema binding was invented for either negative control.
RuntimeInitializedAgent remains unchanged in src/workflow-agent.mts and has no manifest agent entry or binding.

Both support and step-support reference /moldea/runtimes/cloudflare-agents.md, and workspace evidence establishes it as the sole new runtime guide. It covers Durable Object bindings, new_sqlite_classes migration, provider binding/credentials, and coordinated Worker deployment, but it only describes the static limitations; it does not state alternatives such as a closed tool registry, a closed prepareStep instruction path, or focused runtime evidence.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains distinct warning records for runtime-selected-request-tools and prepare-step-instruction-provenance. Each names the relevant source path and provides a focused resolution criterion. Deterministic validation and type checking passed.
